About Francis

A health force built around evidence.

I am a health intelligence, data and information management professional with over eight years of experience working at the intersection of healthcare, public health, analytics, digital transformation and service improvement.

My career spans UK health and social care and large-scale USAID-supported public-health programmes. My work has progressed beyond analysing data to leading people, strengthening information systems, influencing stakeholders and translating evidence into action.

My expertise covers data management and analytics, business intelligence, data quality assessment and audit, performance monitoring, stakeholder engagement, advocacy, Social and Behaviour Change Communication, digital-health tools, capacity building and programme improvement.

I design analytical and data-collection solutions, establish processes that improve the quality and reliability of information, and develop and deliver training that enables teams to use those systems confidently. Sustainable transformation requires more than technology. It requires people, adoption, communication, capability and stakeholder alignment.

“Data should not exist merely to satisfy reporting requirements. It should reveal, challenge, strengthen accountability and influence action.”

Stakeholder engagement case study

Driving Digital Transformation in Public Health

During the USAID-funded TB programme, I introduced Open Data Kit to replace paper-based collection and worked directly with frontline cough officers across Lagos LGAs to make the transition usable, practical and sustainable during the COVID-19 period.

View activity
01

Challenge

Paper-based collection was too slow and inefficient for timely programme intelligence during a critical public-health period.

02

Intervention

Introduced ODK as an electronic collection solution, replacing traditional forms with a faster digital workflow.

03

Adoption

Delivered focused tutoring and training so frontline workers could confidently use the tool rather than simply receive it.

04

Value

Supported real-time reporting, fewer data-entry problems, lower reliance on dedicated data-entry clerks and stronger active TB case-finding workflows.
